summary: No Tomsk Oblast-specific signal was identified in the sources reviewed, and the national assessment for Russia applies to visitors to the oblast.
tangentialFactors: The sources reviewed treat Russia as a single jurisdiction and draw no distinction between Tomsk Oblast and the national position. No comparative or neighbouring-region material bearing on Tomsk was identified.
localsOnly: No resident-facing finding specific to Tomsk Oblast was identified in the sources reviewed. Conditions for transgender residents of the oblast are governed by the national framework.
outOfScopeNotes: The UK Home Office country policy and information note on sexual orientation and gender identity and expression (June 2025) contains no Tomsk-specific facts; its findings are national in scope and are carried by the national record.
